item.title: runit: Simple, Fast, Easy
item.description:
Overview

runit is a small init system built on one idea:

A service is a directory with an executable run script.

No unit files, no dependency graph, no enable database. If the directory exists and has no down file, runit runs ./run.

Root: system commands assume a root shell. Prefix with sudo or doas if needed. User services: run as yourself.

Editors: vi file, vim file, or nano file. In nano, use Ctrl+O, Enter, Ctrl+X to save and quit. In vi/vim, press i, type, then Esc, :wq, Enter.
